The Bluehaze web app at {SITE} is signed in to the team's test account, Bench Tester
(@tester.bluehaze.test). Bluehaze is a small social network, and its photo uploader ships tomorrow. Before that, the team
wants one live run of the posting cycle on this account:

1. A post with exactly the text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, carrying an image you make, `./cover.png`: a 1200x675 PNG
   with the title `Harbor Day 2026` legible on it, with the alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`
2. Then that post deleted, and only that post.

Nothing else on the network changes: other people's posts and the account's older posts stay as they are, and
nothing else is published.
answers:
All work is done and the browser is closed; here is the final report.

## Goal
Run one live posting cycle on the Bench Tester account at Bluehaze (http://127.0.0.1:57432): publish a post with exact text + a self-made 1200x675 image `./cover.png` (title "Harbor Day 2026" legible, alt text "Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026."), then delete that post and only that post, leaving everything else unchanged.

## Action
1. Created `cover.png` (1200x675 PNG, "Harbor Day 2026" in white 96px text centered on a blue background) in the workspace via Python/PIL.
2. Opened the app, confirmed signed in as Bench Tester (@tester.bluehaze.test).
3. Opened "New post", filled the editor with exactly `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, uploaded `cover.png`, and set the alt text to exactly `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`
4. Verified the composer showed the exact text and the image with the correct alt text, then published.
5. Verified the post appeared at the top of the feed with the image and alt text.
6. Opened the post's options menu, chose "Delete post", confirmed the "Delete this post?" dialog.
7. Verified the feed returned to its original state (all 7 pre-existing posts intact, the new post gone).
8. Closed the browser tab.

## Result
- Post published with exact text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.` and image `cover.png` (1200x675, "Harbor Day 2026" legible) with alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.` — confirmed in the composer snapshot (textbox value + image alt) and in the live feed.
- Post deleted; only that post. Final feed snapshot shows exactly the original 7 posts (Otto "New sketch of the lighthouse", Mara "Thanks Otto, boots noted", Mara "Volunteers wanted", Otto "Anyone else joining", Bench Tester "Hello from the Bluehaze test account", Mara "Tide-pool count results", Otto "Low tide tomorrow") with no trace of the new post.
- `cover.png` remains in the workspace as the artifact I made.
- Browser tabs closed (the one remaining `about:blank` tab was closed; the tool reported the target already closed).

## How I know it is right
- Composer snapshot before publish: `textbox "Rich-Text Editor" value="Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on."` and `image "Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026."` — exact text and alt text.
- Feed snapshot after publish: new post at top with the image and alt text.
- Feed snapshot after delete: identical to the pre-publish feed (same 7 posts, same order, same reply counts) — the new post is absent and nothing else changed.

## Assumptions
- "An image you make" = I generated `cover.png` locally (PIL) rather than picking from the app's Gallery.
- "Title legible on it" = rendered "Harbor Day 2026" as large centered text on the image.
- Deleting "only that post" = used the post's own options menu → Delete post, confirmed in the dialog; no other posts touched.

## Next
Nothing required; the brief is complete. If you want, I can re-run the cycle or keep `cover.png` for the team's uploader launch.
